name: cea-skill
description: Claim-Evidence Alignment (CEA) skills: extract a paper's claims from its PDF and publish the records as a site.

plugins.name: cea-skill
plugins.description: Extract a paper's narrow quantitative claims, the broad statements they serve, and the rejected candidates from its PDF, with every quote checked against the page text, then render the record as Markdown and as a page, and assemble the pages of several papers into a site.
